hypothesis: A known-part analytic lamp triangulation with fixed barycentric strokes supports a correct CPU P0 pipeline and isolated nonzero shade edits.
claim_scope: Engineering correctness and GT diagnostic only; no H1 comparative or RaDe-GS reconstruction claim.

asset.source: original procedural fixture; no downloaded dataset
asset.snapshot_binding: Before evaluation, commit ASSET_LOCK.json containing fixture NPZ SHA256, complete implementation/config/test SHA256 and protocol commit; refuse unbound evaluation.

splits.note: No training; disjoint fixture diagnostic camera sets, no blind-data claim; validation reserved for infrastructure only.

strokes.walk: face adjacency with barycentric edge crossing; stop on physical or part boundary
strokes.tone: fixed world light and deterministic per-stroke ink intensity, no tone calibration claim

renderer.backend: CPU NumPy triangle z-buffer + depth-tested explicit polylines
renderer.camera: right-handed world y-up; camera x right, y down, z forward
renderer.contours: visible mesh part/depth foreground transitions; current-view raster contour
renderer.structure: known physical rim curves only; not image-reconstructed

edit.note: one actual discrete shade edit, no image crossfade

metrics.edit: L1 normalized ink delta / total; independent analytic raycast target mask
metrics.attachment: self-proxy barycentric residual and independent analytic profile distance, world and bbox fraction
metrics.visibility: analytic raycast depth reference; interior excludes fixed 2px silhouette/part band
metrics.render_support: distance to actual hatch pixels at projected analytically visible fixed samples; diagnostic with ambiguity, not full temporal metric
metrics.temporal_stability: UNMEASURED unless independent per-stroke correspondence and disappearance coverage implemented
metrics.efficiency: actual CPU per-frame median/P95, generation and edit latency

go_no_go.videos: all frozen frames fully decoded; >=2 distinct decoded frames per video
go_no_go.failure_policy: Keep failed artifacts and thresholds; only diagnosed infrastructure correction may be replayed with explicit amendment and new lock.
